raw.query: WITH issue_cells AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.window_name, d.forecast_model, d.lead_s FROM provenance.v_dim AS d WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND d.experiment = 'factorial' AND d.actuation = 'issue-time' AND d.policy = 'forecast' AND d.quantile = 'p50' AND d.rho = 15 AND d.window_name <> 'aggregate' AND d.run_id LIKE '%:warm:%'), backing AS (SELECT i.window_name, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.bound_ms, i.is_violation FROM provenance.v_infraction AS i JOIN provenance.v_dim AS d USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND d.experiment = 'ctmatrix' AND d.policy = 'forecast' AND d.quantile = 'p50' AND d.rho = 15 AND i.sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99'), matched AS (SELECT c.*, b.achieved_p99_ms, b.bound_ms, b.is_violation FROM issue_cells AS c JOIN backing AS b USING (window_name)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cells, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_violation) AS passing_cells, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_violation) AS failing_cells, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE window_name = 'steady24h') AS calm_cells, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE window_name = 'steady24h' AND is_violation) AS calm_failing_cells, MIN(achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE window_name = 'steady24h') AS calm_min_p99_ms, MAX(achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE window_name = 'steady24h') AS calm_max_p99_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT forecast_model) FILTER (WHERE window_name = 'steady24h') AS calm_models, COUNT(DISTINCT lead_s) FILTER (WHERE window_name = 'steady24h') AS calm_leads, MIN(bound_ms) AS bound_ms, MAX(bound_ms) AS max_bound_ms FROM matched
raw.observed: 24 of 60 cells pass; 36 fail. All 12 calm-day cells across 3 models and 4 leads fail the 1000 ms bound, each with p99 1073.139 ms.
raw.claimed: 23-24 of 60 cells pass; calm-day p99 is 1073 ms at every lead and model.
raw.evidence: The current, non-superseded data gives 24/60 passes and identical calm-day p99 of 1073.139 ms in all 12 model-lead cells, supporting the rounded value and stated range.
